title: Indiana Accommodations
summary: ProAssurance is aware of the recent severe weather in Indiana and stands ready to provide information and assistance with any disaster-related concerns.
body_markdown:
ProAssurance is aware of the recent severe weather in Indiana and stands ready to provide information and assistance with any disaster-related concerns.


**Emergency Order**


On August 13, 2026, Indiana Governor Braun issued[Executive Order 26-21](https://www.in.gov/idoi/files/2026.08.17%20Bulletin%20280%20Signed.pdf)


, which declared a statewide disaster emergency due to the recent severe weather that resulted in significant property damage throughout the state.


ProAssurance is instituting a moratorium for cancellations and nonrenewals due to non-payment of any insurance premium for insureds directly affected by the weather disaster event that occurred during August 11–16. This directive is effective August 10 through October 16 and may be extended.


We will continue to monitor communications for directives related to our insureds and will provide updates as they become available.


**We’re here to help.**


Our Risk Management consultants are available to help you through this difficult time, regardless of insured status. Call the Helpline at (844) 223-9648 or emailRiskAdvisor@ProAssurance.com


.
